remix_prompt: Monster Runner. A satirical game inspired by vaporwave Y2K internet culture built around monster runner play, with competitive, meme, skill based energy, with friends session design, search-friendly hooks like monster runner, casual, addictive, aesthetics like cyber y2k, chrome aesthetic, synthwave, and meme-tone cues such as rizz, ez clap. Designed for one-thumb mobile play with touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, fast onboarding, and portrait-first UX tuned for iOS and Android in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.
